sections.text:
The Gas 
 turbine is equipped with a manually operated fire fighting system. It allows 
 for protection of the unit against fire its most hazardous points, i.e. both 
 the combustion chamber covers, where the fuel burners are located and the 
 turbine outlet bearing which is located within the diffuser.A part from 
 permanent installation the system is connected to fire host too, to fight the 
 fire at other possible locations. The firefighting is based on a medium 
 foam, mixed with water and a foam extract, which extinguishes the fire by 
 means of covering and therefore prevents the oxygen supply.

This document initiated by eng. Gerges Farag Tadros, 
 tested by eng. Afifi Afifi Ebrahim and eng. Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, 
 approved by eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar general director.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman 
 Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator

sections.text:
The 
 principal parts of the type LS 160 stationary foam extinguisher are a water 
 tank (1) containing an extract bottle (6) and
 CO2 
 pressure bottle (2) a hose reel (8) with 25 m unusable hose, fitted with a 
 foam pipe (9) and a connection for permanently installed foam pipping (11).

In order to operate the extinguisher, simply open the valve on the
 CO2bottle 
 (2) and the appropriate spherical cock (4), 
 this allows the CO2 to flow through the pressure line (5) into the extract 
 bottle (6) the pressure ruptures the bursting disk (7) and the extract is 
 forced into the water tank (1) .

A baffle plate on the extract bottle (6) 
 ensures uniform mixing (Approx. 5%). When foam is delivered through foam pipe 
 (9), the mixture of water and extract flows through the spindle of the reel 
 into the hose and foam pipe and expands approximately 15 times as it emerges.

When foam is delivered through the permanently installed pipes (Connection 
 11) and nozzles, the foam expansion is approximately 70 :1 I.e. it is 
 theoretically possible for 150 L of water extract to generate 11 m3 of foam, 
 however, about 50% of this amount is lost through burning and mechanical 
 destruction.

Operating 
 Instructions to Fight a Fire:
Open the valve on the pressure bottle (2) (turn anti-clockwise as far as it will go)

In order to spread foam by means 
 of the hose, unreel as much as
required and open the 
 cock on the pipe.
